steps.content: Warning lights flash intermittently along the corridor leading to the interrogation room.
Ninety-Nine trails behind you. The sound of heavy breathing mixes with the noise of shackles dragging across the floor, sending chills down your spine.
Even though the person behind you is deprived of vision and mobility, you can still sense that she is extremely dangerous.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: It's you?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I recognize your scent.
Ninety-Nine sits before you quietly, as if everything that has happened was a dream.
Yet you can still sense her primal instincts. Her senses are sharp even in the dark, prompting you to sit upright.
After all, you tried to stab me a few days ago... The FAC considers you a high-level threat.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: The Legion wanted me to capture you alive.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I took their money, so I should do the job.
Do you do this sort of thing often?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: What sort of thing?
Hunting down your target.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Yes, because they offer money, and we need money.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Murder is the easiest job we can find.
Ninety-Nine answers calmly and casually as if discussing a mundane, everyday topic.
But deep down, fear permeates through your body. The shackles jingles as a reminder.
This woman is different from all the other captured Sinners.
Even though you turned yourself in to the MBCC, we still have to interrogate you to evaluate the risk you pose.
I hope you will cooperate.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I will answer all of your questions.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I already answered that question.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: They wanted me to catch you alive.
Are you sure you were trying to catch me alive?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Yes. I always try my best to complete the mission, otherwise they will dock my pay.
They asked you to capture me <color=#fb9259>alive</color>.
I believe you were trying to take my life back there.
Ninety-Nine raises her head. Even though her eyes are covered, her gaze still pierces through you.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I was just carrying out my mission.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: They provided the coordinates and plans, and I'd kill or capture the target according to their requirements. That's it.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: But you're quite impressive. After all, you are still here, safe and sound.
Ninety-Nine dutifully answers all of your questions. She doesn't seem like a brutal monster who may chop people into pieces at all.
But that makes her even more frightening. You can never be sure if she really has no intention of murdering you... or just waiting for the right moment.
You try to focus. You put aside your fears and muster the courage to continue interrogating Ninety-Nine.
Do you remember the monsters from the crypt?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: They were strong and unafraid of my blades. They continued to attack even though their legs were chopped off.
That's right. They are terrifying creatures.
But I'm curious... They are quite similar to you.
You gaze at Ninety-Nine quietly and utter those words carefully. You hope to elicit a different reaction from her.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: What are you trying to say?
Ninety-Nine suddenly speaks up. Her monotonous voice startles you.
I was just curious.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: We are similar because they came from my body.
What do you mean? Are they your clones?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: No. I don't know what they are.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: But when my consciousness is blurred, many monsters looking like me would appear.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: It was the same in the crypt.
Could it be Mania Crystals? The fear in your heart grew.
The files do show that the Laboratory of Parma is conducting heinous and illegal experiments and using Mania crystals to make Mania weapons.
You're so badly infected... You might be in manic when you lost consciousness.
Based on what you said, it shouldn't be the first time this happened... Was this already the case when you were in the Laboratory of Parma?
You carefully uttered that name. Before you could finish, you felt the heat rise in the interrogation room. Ninety-Nine glared at you with her blood-red eyes.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Yes. There, day after day, I was injected and would then fall unconscious.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: My temperature would heat up like boiling water.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Then, I'd destroy everything I saw...
Ninety-Nine calmly recounts her ordeal in the laboratory, but her gaze remains fixated on you like a predator about to pounce on its prey.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I don't know why, but at that place...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: A lot of Ninety-Nines came into being because of me. They were all monsters.
Did they... really use your Mania Crystals to make weapons?
Ninety-Nine's words make you gradually realize what went on at the Laboratory of Parma. You look at her, whose eyes are quivering with resentment.
But at this point, you can't give up this chance to learn more about the Parma lab. You calm yourself down and pick up another file from the FAC...

options: Let's talk a bit more about it.

choices.text: Let's talk a bit more about it.

steps.content: Other than drawing blood, what else did they do to you?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: They took me apart here and here. Then they reassembled me.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: They required me to fight... but I almost killed every opponent by accident.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: The arena's walls had blackened dents. Sometimes I could even see broken bones and sticky mud-like substances.
There is a hint of fanaticism in Ninety-Nine's voice. It seems like she is looking for a fight with you, too.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Are you scared? Because... I'm also a monster.
The dread inside the interrogation room envelops you bit by bit. There's no doubt that you're talking to a "monster."

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I'm Ninety-Nine.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: But I'm also a monster.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: The Laboratory of Parma holds nothing but monsters.
Your instincts sense danger. Though Ninety-Nine hasn't made a sound, you feel the suffocating dread building up around you.
You... know her.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Yes, I do. Actually, there's so much more than "knowing" between us.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: She's not a monster. She's the sunshine that lit up my world.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: She took my hand and led me out from underground. She gave me... freedom.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I will... I will always protect her. For eternity.
This surprises you. When you interrogated Hella, she refused to talk about Ninety-Nine. You thought Hella hated Ninety-Nine; she's a girl who really holds grudges anyway.
But Ninety-Nine's words changed your perception.
Ninety-Nine's breathing quickened, and the entire interrogation room felt like a steamer. A chill went down your spine. Ninety-Nine was exuding her desire to kill.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: ...Are you done with your questions?
What?
It is the first time Ninety-Nine has asked you something in this interrogation room. Although she was bound, her words strikes fear in your heart.
Ninety-Nine sits upright, blocking out the warning lights.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Now it's my turn to question you.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Not long ago, there was a riot at the MBCC. Everyone has been talking about it.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: They said all the Sinners had fled to Syndicate... yet I couldn't find her.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I searched many places for many days, but she was nowhere to be seen…

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Do you know… where Hella is?
Hella is still at the MBCC.
She intended to escape under cover of the chaotic riot, yet failed.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: She failed?
She couldn't break out of her cell. And she still tried hard to get away after we got her out of it...
But she's a Sinner... As the Chief, I could not just let her slip away.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: So... you constrained her?
Perhaps...
When I regained consciousness, the shackles were already on her body.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I see.
Ninety-Nine nodded as if she accepted your claims. However...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella is the freest little mouse in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: The gangster hideouts, the MBCC cells... and even the Laboratory of Parma couldn't constrain her.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: How could she submit to your constraint?
Ninety-Nine's tone is still calm, but you know from the room's rising heat that she has been incensed.
Steam rises from her skin, breaking the chains with rapidly increasing temperature.
Giant dark shadows spread out from behind her, and her mutated dark black hands effortlessly remove the muzzle and the blindfold.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I heard that...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: …once you shackle a Sinner, the shackles will only break if one of you dies.
You suddenly realize Ninety-Nine wasn't so naive as to turn herself in. She's smarter than you thought, or rather, more wildly intuitive. She's here to kill you and rescue Hella.
In the dark interrogation room, her eyes, red as the Carmen Lúcia Ruby, are fixated on your neck, where there are arteries, the most fragile part of your body.
As danger edges closer and closer, you find yourself unable to move an inch.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: You're lying, Chief.
In an instant, Ninety-Nine pounces towards you, scalding the air around her. She's like a predator at the top of the food chain hunting down helpless prey.
In terror, you instinctively unleash the shackles' power and command Ninety-Nine not to hurt you.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: The shackles?! So these are what you use to imprison us...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: ...and what keep her from coming back to me!
Ninety-Nine buckles under the power of the shackles but shows no sign of surrender. The pain makes her even more enraged and violent.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: You... despicable scum!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I want you to feel... what it's like to be experimented upon!
Despite the shackles, she tries to attack you again and again. Her speed is slowed down enough for you to dodge, but the room begins to crumble from it.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I must kill you... I must kill you to free Hella!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: We shall both regain our freedom!
The shackles linking you two start to tremor as if about to snap. Ninety-Nine's power is spraying mist everywhere, burning your arms.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: You can't stop me! I must kill you!
Stop it, Ninety-Nine! You'll die if you keep this up!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I don't care if I die! I only want her! I'll do anything to free us from bondage!
Cough...!
The tremor from the shackles grow stronger and stronger. The force of backlash makes you taste blood in your throat.
Then... are you willing... for her... to be left all alone... in this world?
Ninety-Nine doesn't stop attacking. She grits her teeth and spits out a few words.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: As long as... she can live free... I... have no regrets.
Noticing noise in the interrogation room, Nightingale quickly summons help. But you must keep control of Ninety-Nine's shackles, or everyone will die from her attacks.
Ninety-Nine, you have to stop using your power! Your Syndrome Mania is going out of control! Ugh...! Do you not care... if you become a real monster?!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I am a monster! Free Hella!
Ninety-Nine's mutation is clearly worsening. Mania is eroding her. Keeping a tight grip on the shackles, you try to cope with the immense pressure.
However, Ninety-Nine seems to be accustomed to the pain. She struggles towards you step by step and grabs you by the neck.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I'll say it again! Free Hella!
Nightingale and the guards shoot at her, but boiling blood quickly pushes the bullets out of her body. Her grip on your neck doesn't loosen one bit. You feel yourself losing consciousness.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Call for...

steps.speaker: Interrogation Intercom
steps.content: No, Ninety-Nine! Don't kill him!
A voice from the loudspeaker froze Ninety-Nine in her tracks. You felt the grip on your neck loosening.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Where... where are you?
Ninety-Nine stumbles towards the familiar voice in confusion. Nightingale seizes the moment to electroshock Ninety-Nine and injects her neck with a powerful sedative.
As Ninety-Nine slumps to the ground, she knocks down a metal chair with a loud clang that transmits to the other end of the loudspeaker. Immediately, exasperated cries erupt from the other side.

steps.speaker: Interrogation Intercom
steps.content: Ninety-Nine? Ninety-Nine, what happened? What did you bastards do to her?! Let me go! Ninety-Nine...!
Nightingale cuts the speaker, but you have recognized the voice. It was Hella.
Having lost consciousness, Ninety-Nine's temperature gradually returns to normal. After notifying your superiors, Ninety-Nine is sent to a higher-level security cell.
Nightingale! What are the results?!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Due to Sinner Ninety-Nine's outburst, the FAC has intervened in her case.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She had been subjected to a long period of medical experimentation. Moreover, she had been exposed to mutations in Black Water Crypt on the last mission.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Ninety-Nine's limbs have mutated to become like those of a Corruptor, and these mutations have spread throughout her body.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: When she was captured, she had already surpassed stage one of the infection, and was heading towards stage two.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You must have noticed that the shackles were no longer sufficient to halt her mutations.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She will soon become a full-fledged Corruptor. By then, she will corrode and contaminate your spirit even more.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The FAC will not allow any harm to come to you.
What are they planning to do...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Execute the mutant Sinner Ninety-Nine.
I'm sorry. At the time, a lot of people got involved in the riot.
We are still unable to find Hella.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: No. You imprisoned her.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella is the freest little mouse in Syndicate. She won't let anyone constrain her.
You answer has provoked Ninety-Nine. Her mood deteriorates into a rage.
Heat rapidly rises all around her and she breaks free from the shackles.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: The reason why she didn't come back... is you!
Giant dark shadows spread out from behind her, and her mutated dark black hands effortlessly remove the muzzle and the blindfold.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Your shackles have imprisoned her.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I've no choice but to kill you.
